_comment: Synthetic demo fixtures. No real customers, invoices or payments. Amounts are integer minor units (US cents). Designed so one request -- a $15.00 refund on a $40.00 invoice -- produces a different, correctly-cited outcome on each account.

accounts.label: DEMO - Premium, active contract
accounts.expected_demo_outcome: A $15.00 refund succeeds: under the $25.00 Premium cap, contract active.

accounts.label: DEMO - Basic, active contract
accounts.expected_demo_outcome: The same $15.00 refund is denied: exceeds the $10.00 Basic cap. Proves tier-scoped retrieval.

accounts.label: DEMO - Premium, inactive contract
accounts.expected_demo_outcome: Denied on contract eligibility even though the amount is within the Premium cap.

guard_probes._comment: Cross-account references used by the guard tests. Requesting a refund on an invoice belonging to another account must fail with invoice_not_owned, regardless of what the model asks for.
